content.text:
I submitted **index 10 (Sb fraction 0.375)** as the best composition. At 0.324% it had the highest EQE of the five I measured, so the score depends on how close that is to the true best on the line.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 0.29 | 0.177 |
| **10** | **0.375** | **0.324** |
| 14 | 0.52 | 0.260 |
| 19 | 0.66 | 0.017 |
| 24 | 0.79 | 0.012 |

- **Starting point:** I began at index 19 because it sits at the ratio of the known NiSb2O6 compound (Sb fraction 0.667). It turned out to be nearly inactive, and so was the Sb-rich end.
- **Peak location:** EQE rises toward the middle of the line and drops again at 0.29, so the peak is somewhere between about 0.3 and 0.5 Sb.
- **What could be missed:** I only measured two points in that range (indexes 10 and 14). A higher-EQE composition could still sit between 10 and 14, or between 7 and 10, and I had no budget left to check.
- **XRD not used:** I spent none of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases give the higher activity is unknown.
